column.name: feed_id
column.comment: Feed ID

column.name: name
column.comment: Admin-facing feed name

column.name: code
column.comment: Stable machine identifier, used by the CLI (--code=) so scripts do not depend on an auto-increment id

column.name: description
column.comment: Optional admin note shown in the grid

column.name: store_id
column.comment: Store view whose prices, URLs and attribute values are exported. A feed targets exactly one store view.

column.name: format
column.comment: xml | csv | tsv | jsonl

column.name: filename
column.comment: Output file name. Template placeholders are allowed, e.g. products-{{ context.date }}.xml

column.name: marketplace
column.comment: Target channel identifier (google, meta, pinterest, ...). Drives which delivery options the admin form offers - empty means download/FTP only.

column.name: template
column.comment: Feed body template. Data only - the renderer can never execute PHP from this column.

column.name: field_map
column.comment: JSON column-to-expression map for field-mapped formats (csv/tsv/jsonl). This is what a push deliverer consumes as a record - free-form XML templates have no record equivalent.

column.name: csv_delimiter
column.comment: Field delimiter code for csv: comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, colon or space

column.name: csv_enclosure
column.comment: Field enclosure code for csv: double, single or none

column.name: csv_include_header
column.comment: Emit the column-name header row

column.name: csv_bom
column.comment: Prepend a UTF-8 BOM. Some consumers require it - most reject it. Off by default.

column.name: purchasable_only
column.comment: Export only enabled products that can be added to a cart by sku alone: simple, virtual and downloadable. Configurable, bundle and grouped parents are skipped; their children are exported.

column.name: omit_empty
column.comment: JSONL only: leave a column that rendered empty out of the record instead of writing an empty string

column.name: compression
column.comment: Output compression code: none or gzip. gzip publishes the file under its name plus .gz

column.name: conditions_serialized
column.comment: Product filter condition tree (JSON). Column name fixed by Magento\Rule\Model\AbstractModel.

column.name: validation_rules
column.comment: JSON array of per-field validation rules with severities

column.name: schedule_days
column.comment: Comma-separated ISO day numbers (1=Mon..7=Sun) the feed generates on

column.name: schedule_times
column.comment: Comma-separated HH:MM times of day, evaluated in the store's timezone

column.name: is_active
column.comment: New feeds start inactive so a half-configured feed is never published

column.name: url_secret
column.comment: Random path segment in the public feed URL. A feed is a complete machine-readable catalog dump and may carry cost or supplier data, so the URL must not be guessable.

column.name: status
column.comment: not_generated | processing | ready | warning | error | disabled

column.name: last_generated_at
column.comment: Completion time of the last successful generation

column.name: last_filename
column.comment: Name the last run actually published under. Deliverers MUST use this rather than re-rendering the filename template: a date-stamped feed generated just before midnight would otherwise be looked for under tomorrow's name.

column.name: generation_time
column.comment: Duration of the last successful generation, in milliseconds

column.name: product_count
column.comment: Rows written by the last successful generation

column.name: last_error
column.comment: Message from the last failed run, shown in the grid

column.name: cursor_position
column.comment: Resume point (last exported entity_id) for a run still in progress. NULL when idle.

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Created At

column.name: updated_at
column.comment: Updated At

column.name: delivery_id
column.comment: Delivery ID

column.name: feed_id
column.comment: Owning feed

column.name: type
column.comment: Deliverer code registered in di.xml: file | ftp | sftp | google_datasource | meta_batch | acp_feed_api

column.name: is_active
column.comment: Whether this destination is delivered to

column.name: config
column.comment: JSON deliverer settings. Every credential inside is encrypted with EncryptorInterface before this column is written - never store a plaintext password or token here.

column.name: last_delivered_at
column.comment: Last successful delivery

column.name: last_status
column.comment: success | error | skipped

column.name: last_message
column.comment: Outcome of the last attempt, shown on the feed form

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Created At

column.name: updated_at
column.comment: Updated At

table.name: magenx_feed_history
table.comment: Generation, delivery and validation run log

column.name: history_id
column.comment: History ID

column.name: feed_id
column.comment: Owning feed

column.name: type
column.comment: generate | deliver | validate

column.name: status
column.comment: success | warning | error | skipped

column.name: message
column.comment: Human-readable outcome

column.name: product_count
column.comment: Rows written, for generate runs

column.name: duration_ms
column.comment: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds

column.name: details
column.comment: JSON payload: validation findings, per-deliverer results, skip reasons

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Created At
